name: CANDEO HOTELS Osaka The Tower
detail: The room was spacious and clean, and I requested a high floor, which I got as I hoped. I used the spa, but even around midnight there were no available lockers, and there were many users, so I returned to my room and came back an hour later. I still think there were more than ten users. Aside from the fact that there was a mountain of bath towels, the location of the outdoor hot spring was excellent, and the washing area was clean. Breakfast was also busy, but there were plenty of tables to sit at, and the food was delicious. The staff provided excellent service as well. I had a very comfortable stay, so I will use it again.

name: APA HOTEL＆RESORT OSAKA NAMBA EKIMAE TOWER
detail: Overall, it was a satisfying accommodation. I really liked the large public bath, as I used it in the morning and evening. There were about 5 to 6 pools, and the water was very clean with good hot spring water. I went there every day with my child. The room was small, but since we used a two-bed setup, it was fine. It was enjoyable for the two of us. There was a brief power outage, and the window wouldn't close, but the staff came and kindly resolved the issue. I think it offers good value for money. Also, the bus to the airport was really just a one-minute walk away, which was great. The structure allows the suitcase to be placed under the bed. If I go again, I think I'll stay here when I visit Osaka. It takes about 10 minutes to walk to Dotonbori, but I don't mind since walking in Osaka is fun. Plus, the JR Namba Line is right in front if I want to go towards Umeda, which is convenient.

name: Capsule Hotel Asahi Plaza Shinsaibashi
detail: I have stayed here several times. This time, perhaps due to a special rate from Agoda, the price per night was cheaper than usual. At check-in, when I answered that I have stayed before, it was smooth without any extra explanation. There were quite a few foreign guests, and the staff provided fluent assistance in English. There were also some staff members from overseas. The capsule was sufficiently spacious and equipped. The bath and sauna are large. However, compared to that, there are only a few chairs in the bathing area for resting after the sauna. Additionally, some facilities are aging, including toilets that cannot be used, and automatic doors that were manual. Many lockers for storing luggage before the bath were also unusable, and since there are not many of them, I thought it would be good to fix them. Overall, it's very convenient to stay at a low price within walking distance of Shinsaibashi and Namba (even without this special discount). It may only be sustainable as long as the facilities can be maintained, but I hope it lasts for a long time.

name: APA Hotel & Resort Osaka Umeda Eki Tower
detail: I've always wanted to stay at this APA resort hotel because it has complete facilities. The gym requires a reservation, and I felt too shy to go to the pool because there was no one else. Despite this, I feel like I spent two days on vacation, restoring my body's fatigue. The room was especially clean and very comfortable. In the extremely hot weather at the end of July, I could enjoy a cool feeling in the room. Sleeping under the comforter with the central air conditioning set to 21 degrees was fantastic. There are many great dining spots near the hotel. I went for barbecued meat for two consecutive days. The prices are also very reasonable. Good restaurants require reservations in advance; otherwise, there won't be any seats available if you just walk in. The hot spring was very comfortable and clean. Breakfast is served on the top floor, the 34th floor, where you can enjoy the view. Additionally, having raw eggs (egg yolk) mixed with rice is simply my favorite. In Japan, the best rice paired with raw egg absolutely offers a texture that cannot be experienced in other countries. The APA resort hotel is much better than regular APAs.

name: APA Hotel Namba-Eki Higashi
detail: I chose this place as a base for sightseeing at Namba Grand Kagetsu and Dotonbori. It is right in front of the Grand Kagetsu, and there are plenty of bars in the back streets of Namba, with Dotonbori just a short walk away, making it a great location. The staff were also kind and courteous; when I asked for recommendations for nighttime dining spots, they provided me with a handwritten map, which was fantastic. It might have just been a coincidence, but aside from the unusually dirty restroom on the first floor, the room was exceptionally clean and wonderful. Breakfast was a bit pricey at 1900 yen, but compared to other business hotels, the menu was rich with a mix of Japanese and Western options, so I think the quality is quite good. With Namba Station nearby, it’s convenient for train travel, and having a dedicated parking lot makes it easy to come by car as well. I will definitely return.

name: APA Hotel and Resort Midosuji Hommachi Ekimae Tower
detail: Overall, I am very satisfied with my stay at the APA Hotel in Osaka, and it is the type of choice I would prioritize for my next visit. The location is very convenient, making travel easy without much thought, whether going to attractions, shopping, or transferring between trains. The check-in and check-out processes are smooth and efficient, so there's hardly any time wasted in lines. The room is overall clean and tidy; although not large, the layout is reasonable and it has everything needed, making it user-friendly. The bedding is quite comfortable, allowing for restful sleep at night; the soundproofing and privacy are also within acceptable ranges, with no significant disturbances. The bathroom and shower area are well maintained, with stable hot water and water pressure, which is a plus for business trips or travel. In terms of service, it feels standardized yet effective, and communication is smooth in case of any issues. Overall, it offers great value for money and is suitable for those who want a hassle-free experience, prioritize efficiency, and have basic requirements for accommodation quality. I recommend it.

name: APA Hotel Shin-Osaka ekimae
detail: It is close to Shin-Osaka Station and located on the east side of the station, so the surrounding area is relatively quiet, and the location is very good. The hotel is clean and has a more upscale impression compared to a typical business hotel. The room was slightly on the smaller side, but it was sufficient for one person, and I was able to stay comfortably. I was also happy to have a large public bath, which I used twice, once in the evening and once in the morning. It was very nice to relieve the fatigue from my business trip and travel. The breakfast is a bit on the expensive side, but the selection was substantial, and I was satisfied. I would like to use this hotel again when staying around Shin-Osaka Station.

name: APA Hotel Osaka Higobashi Ekimae Tower
detail: I reserved a double room for two people. The bus stop, subway station, and Keihan are all nearby, making it easily accessible. There is also a large public bath with cleansing items available. Each floor has a water server and microwave, which was convenient. The room was clean, and there were paper cups, numerous outlets, and amenities. I felt that they really understood the guests' needs. The staff members were all kind as well. If I had to mention something unfortunate, it would be the lack of seating space on the front desk floor, the pajamas having strings, and the room being small. There are also delicious restaurants nearby, and I really liked it to the point that I would want to make it my regular accommodation when I go to Osaka.

name: Hotel Shin Imamiya
detail: Shin-Imamiya Station has both JR and NANKAI, making it very convenient for travel to and from Kansai Airport. Around the accommodation, there are both Lawson and Family Mart supermarkets, and Spa World is within walking distance, very comfortable. The reception staff are friendly and eager to help. The chosen room has an en-suite bathroom with a bathtub, and since it's on the second floor, there is a laundry room available. Washing clothes costs 200-300 yen per load, and drying clothes is 100 yen for 30 minutes. The laundry detergent can be purchased at the front desk for about 50 yen, but we bought our own laundry liquid outside because we don’t like the provided detergent. There is also a shared men's shower room for use. We went with three kids, and during the busy mornings, there is a shared shower room available for use.

name: The GALA Hotel Umeda
detail: As soon as I opened the door, I was healed by a wonderful fragrance. The staff were very pleasant and kind, which made me feel at ease. The room was also very clean, and the bathroom and toilet had an excellent sense of cleanliness. Regarding the price, I used it during the fireworks festival, so it was a bit expensive, but if you use it for regular stays, I think it would be very affordable! I plan to use it again when I come to Osaka.
